task_prompt: Design a skill for forecasting a land parcel's satellite band values with the synthetic historical control method of Chen, Yang and Yang. The paper, Synthetic Historical Control for Policy Evaluation, is at `paper/ssrn-4995085.pdf`. The agent that uses the skill works in a directory holding `data.csv`, one parcel's own history of several bands, one row per band and time point. It predicts every band's value at the time point after that history and writes `answer.json` as {"prediction": {"<band>": <number>, ...}, "rationale": "<text>"}. The agent has a bash shell and no network access.
